function.name: list_skills
function.description: List available player skills with short metadata only.

function.name: read_skill
function.description: Read one skill document by id. If id omitted, the active skill may be used.

function.name: read_subdoc
function.description: Read one markdown sub-document inside a skill directory by relative path.

id.description: Optional skill id from list_skills. Defaults to active skill.

path.description: Relative markdown path, for example subdocs/roof-gable.md.

function.name: search_skill
function.description: Search text snippets in a skill by query.

id.description: Optional skill id. Defaults to active skill.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Updates the task plan. Provide an optional explanation and a list of plan items, each with a step and status. At most one step can be in_progress at a time.

function.name: request_user_choice
function.description: Request explicit user approval/selection from 2-3 options, then wait for user choice.

function.name: clear_user_choice
function.description: Clear pending user choice request.

function.name: get_project_state
function.description: Get the current project overview, workspace file list, pending paths, and summary.

function.name: read_workspace_file
function.description: Read a workspace file state including size, origin, revision, and TOML content. Returns workspace_toml, and may set truncated=true when the text is shortened.

committed.description: Defaults to true (committed script). Set false only when staged script is needed for UI diff.

function.name: create_workspace_file
function.description: Create a new workspace file in the current project.

name.description: Display name for the workspace file.

path.description: Logical project path, such as workspace/floors/f1.toml.

function.name: rename_workspace_file
function.description: Rename a workspace file and optionally update its logical path.

function.name: delete_workspace_file
function.description: Delete a workspace file if it has no pending patch and it is not the last remaining file.

function.name: search_block_ids
function.description: Search valid block IDs by keyword or partial id.

query.description: Keyword or partial block id to search.

function.name: propose_patch
function.description: Propose an editable structure patch using TOML text in patch_toml. The TOML body supports base_revision, intent, message_to_user, repeated [[operation]] tables, nested [[operation.actions_add]] / [[operation.old_actions]] / [[operation.new_actions]] tables, and [[operation.entry]] for palette updates.

path.description: Workspace file path this patch applies to.

patch_toml.description: Patch body in TOML. Top-level keys: base_revision, intent, message_to_user. Use [[operation]] with op=insert_part|delete_part|replace_part|insert_actions|delete_actions|replace_actions|move_actions|update_palette. Use insert_part for a brand-new part, and reserve insert_actions for appending to an existing part. For actions, use nested [[operation.actions_add]], [[operation.old_actions]], [[operation.new_actions]]. For palette updates, use [[operation.entry]] where omitting old_value means add-new and omitting new_value means delete.

function.name: list_subagents
function.description: List all subagents created in this session.

include_deleted.description: Whether deleted subagents should be included.

function.name: create_subagent
function.description: Create and run an asynchronous subagent task using a profile.

task.description: Task description passed to the subagent.

profile_id.description: Optional profile id. Defaults to general-planner.

metadata.description: Optional metadata forwarded to subagent context.

function.name: continue_subagent
function.description: Continue a failed/completed/cancelled subagent with optional new instruction.

instruction.description: Optional follow-up instruction for the continued run.

function.name: get_subagent
function.description: Get full status and result of a subagent by id.

function.name: delete_subagent
function.description: Delete a subagent by id.

function.name: list_profiles
function.description: List available subagent profiles.

function.name: get_profile
function.description: Read one subagent profile by id.
